speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have a history of gait and limb ataxia; to better understand your condition, could you please describe exactly how you have experienced these symptoms and when they began?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: The patient reports recent onset of gait and limb ataxia, appearing "drunk" when walking, with clumsiness specifically noted on the right side. To help localize the lesion, do you experience any double vision, drooping eyelids, or trouble swallowing or speaking?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.
